svg.title: APEX 04 — Every persona feels the problem differently
svg.text: PERSONA PAIN POINTS VS BUSINESS VALUE
Every persona feels the problem differently
The same three problems show up as different pains for each persona. Match each pain to a capability
that exists today, and describe the value in that persona’s own terms — never with unproven figures.

g.text: Too many tools, too many logins
One sign-in, scoped roles and an audit
Growth depends on a few experts

svg.text: Open every conversation with the persona’s own pain, show only the capability that answers
it, and state the value as an outcome to be measured in the pilot — not as a promised number.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
November 2026 · Internal sales enablement · A0 841 × 1189 mm
